item.title: About me
item.description: clouds restore in rain the exhalations of the land and sea -H. W. Longfellow This snippet from Longfellow’s prelude to Michael Angelo describes the water cycle: the movement of water around the Earth. I am a climate scientist, tackling the same topic but using science. I try to understand the huge range of factors influencing when, where, and why rain falls in different places around the world - and how that is changing because of climate change.

item.title: News
item.description: 5 October 2026 I’m chuffed to have officially signed on to the POW Science Alliance. Protect Our Winters is a global collective of outdoor enthusiasts, athletes, scientists, and anyone concerned about what climate change is doing to our precious alpine environments. Here in Australia the impact of climate change on our alpine environments is terrifyingly stark, with snow seasons already distinctly shorter than they were just a few decades ago. This has major effects not just on the unique and fragile snow-adapted ecosystems, but on people and businesses relying on strong winter seasons.
